name: MASCOT SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED
capabilities: Sealing solutions for vacuum and thermal processes
india_angle: Mascot Systems is an authorized supplier of DuPont™ Kalrez® in India, indicating a strong local presence in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Mascot Systems Private Limited is an engineering solutions company that provides specialty products for the semiconductor industry, focusing on sealing and pumping technologies that enhance safety and performance. They are a key distributor of high-performance products like DuPont™ Kalrez® seals and PSG Dover pumps, which are critical for maintaining high purity and reliability in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
